patterns.note: The hero section features a fixed, large text overlay positioned over a dynamic, shifting collage of project images that scroll and animate underneath.
Section headings are presented in a very large, bold sans-serif typeface with generous line spacing, creating clear visual breaks and hierarchy.
The site uses a stark monochromatic base of black text on a white background, allowing the vibrant and diverse colors of the project photography to stand out.

As the user scrolls, the main hero text remains fixed at the top of the viewport while a background collage of project images scrolls and subtly shifts, creating a parallax effect. Subsequent content sections reveal with a gentle fade-in or slide-up as they enter the viewport.
Content sections are introduced by a single, prominent left-aligned heading, followed by a grid or list of related items, often with ample whitespace above and below the heading.

technique_notes: The hero section is built with a fixed text layer positioned above a dynamically scrolling and animating image collage. This creates a parallax effect where the text appears to float over the moving visuals. The detected 'lottie' animation tech is likely used to power the complex transitions and movements within this image collage.
As the user scrolls down the page, new content sections are introduced with a subtle reveal animation, such as a fade-in or a slight upward slide, ensuring a smooth and engaging content flow.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold headings (~3-4x body) with generous line height, paired with a clean, legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners throughout, applied to all image containers and content blocks.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, particularly in the hero and section introductions, transitioning to a more balanced density within content grids and listings.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the highly dynamic and interactive hero section. The main heading remains fixed while a complex, shifting collage of project images scrolls and animates underneath it, creating a unique and engaging visual introduction that immediately showcases the firm's creative work.
